scene: The harvests at {destination} have failed and the stores are nearly gone.
{destination} has been on short rations for weeks, and it is getting worse.
Word from {destination} says the markets there have stopped taking credits for food.
The grain ships stopped calling at {destination} a while ago and nobody can say why.
task: I need {tonnes} t of {cargo} landed at {destination} inside {deadline}.
Carry {tonnes} t of {cargo} from {system} to {destination}. {deadline} at most.
{tonnes} t of {cargo} are waiting at {system}. They need to be at {destination} in {deadline}.
success: The {cargo} is unloaded under armed guard. {faction} pays {reward}.
Queues form before you've finished docking. {faction} pays {reward}.
A dockmaster signs for {tonnes} t of {cargo} with shaking hands. {faction} pays {reward}.
The price of food at {destination} drops by half before the day is out. {faction} pays {reward}, and the dockers remember your ship's name.
failure: The relief never arrived. {destination} will remember the name of your ship.
{faction} sends another captain. They won't send you again.

detail: Nothing can be sent through the gates by other means, which is why we are talking.
It is smaller than your fist and worth more than your ship, or nothing at all. I would not like to guess.

success: The recipient checks the seal, nods, and {faction} pays {reward}.
